LanguageData.MakeStandardAnimalArmorHuge.label: make standard animal armor (huge)
LanguageData.MakeStandardAnimalArmorHuge.description:
Make a set of standard animal armor out of steel, plasteel and cloth lining.
Fits on animals with a mature body size of 2.4 or greater.

LanguageData.MakeStandardAnimalArmorLarge.description:

Fits on animals with a mature body size of 1.3 or greater, but less than 2.4.
